title: What Is a Theory Worth to an LLM Solver? Measuring, Inducing, and Merging Theories in Context
abstract: arXiv:2611.34751v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Mathematicians solve problems faster when they know the right theory. We ask how much a stated theory is worth to a large language model (LLM) solver, and whether a model can write that theory itself. In a length-matched protocol, adding the right theory to the context of Qwen3-14B raises pass@1 on pattern waiting-time problems from 0.37 to 0.83 and cuts the median tokens of correct solutions from 10.2k to 6.3k, while worked examples of the same length do not help. The gain shrinks as the solver and its token budget grow (+0.46, +0.26, +0.07), and at a long budget it comes almost entirely from finishing within budget: solutions that finish are correct 98--100\% of the time in every condition. To separate induction from recall, we plant unpublished theorems in custom probability families and measure how much of the oracle theory's gain an induced theory recovers. translated_title: 理论对LLM求解器价值几何？在上下文中测量、归纳与合并理论
translated_abstract: 数学家在掌握正确理论时能更快地解决问题。我们探究一个明确的陈述理论对大型语言模型（LLM）求解器的价值有多大，以及模型能否自己写出这样的理论。在一个长度匹配的实验协议中，向 Qwen3-14B 的上下文中加入正确的理论，可使模式等待时间问题的 pass@1 从 0.37 提升至 0.83，并将正确解答的 token 中位数从 10.2k 降至 6.3k，而同等长度的详细例题并无帮助。随着求解器能力及其 token 预算的增大，这一增益逐渐缩小（+0.46、+0.26、+0.07），且在较长预算下增益几乎完全来自“能在预算内完成解答”：在所有条件下，能够完成的解答正确率均达 98–100%。为了将归纳与记忆回忆区分开，我们在自定义的概率问题族中植入未发表过的定理，并测量归纳所得理论能恢复多少神谕理论（oracle theory）所带来的增益。一个强大的开源模型在被要求用代码探索训练问题后……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该研究通过受控实验量化了正确理论对LLM数学解题的巨大价值（使Qwen3-14B的pass@1从0.37提升至0.83、解答token消耗近乎减半），并证明模型能够通过代码探索自主归纳出未知的新理论、且可将多个理论合并以获得更强收益。
en_tdlr: This work quantifies the substantial value of the right theory for an LLM solver—raising Qwen3-14B's pass@1 from 0.37 to 0.83 while nearly halving solution tokens—and demonstrates that models can induce unpublished theories themselves by exploring problems with code and can merge multiple theories for further gains.
